author: independent_agent
concept: A lampworker heats the missing central bead for a glass necklace with a bench-mounted gas torch during a rainy studio evening.

requester_authorization.scope: The requesting user authorized three independent random complex concept tests using the supplied image, prompt generation, image generation and pixel review.

precore_access_policy.source_materials: Current user request, coordinator-neutral authorization, supplied reference, general knowledge, SKILL.md and exact permitted neutral precore files only before freeze.

considered: A brazing repair of a miniature brass hinge
Lampworking a final central necklace bead with a stationary gas torch
independent_concept_comparison.selected_reason: The stationary flame, rotating mandrel, hot bead and completed cool beads form an understandable production chain while remaining within one image; the face and attention can be present alongside the tool without hiding contact.

success_criteria.requirement: A recognizably visible flame emerges from the bench-mounted torch nozzle with one continuous owner-source connection.
The flame reaches the hot bead on the mandrel; a glowing unrelated object elsewhere does not pass.
Blue flame morphology and orange heated glass read as separate phenomena; firelight reflections cannot substitute for flame.
Hands belong to the depicted person; mandrel supports/rotation and paddle space are physically plausible and visible.
Reference-guided face and black bob/bangs remain recognizably compatible without asserting biometric identity.
Cool matching beads or the necklace gap make the fabrication purpose readable.
